items.title: A new look: Modern
items.text: Black and gold, flat and light, with new line icons and the tabs across the top. Classic stays in Settings, Appearance, Theme.

items.title: The right episode, clean sources
items.text: Fake files, programs and sources of another episode are left out, and a pack plays the episode you opened.

items.title: Play starts sooner
items.text: The best stream is chosen as soon as a good one is there, addons answer side by side, and a real upscale joins Settings.

items.title: Safer and lighter
items.text: A smaller app that keeps to itself on your network, and takes its updates only from this project.
